crossRefs.note: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am…
especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me…
Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”
Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly…
and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any…
But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”
They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him…

translations.web: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.
translations.bsb: For the king knows about these matters, and I can speak freely to him. I am confident that none of this has escaped his notice, because it was not done in a corner.
translations.kjv: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
translations.asv: For the king knoweth of these things, unto whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him; for this hath not been done in a corner.
